name: UCLA Spring 2025
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLASpring2025#55412-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ### UCLA Students If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCLASpring2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
